```{r}

block_b<-read_rds("/mmfs1/gscratch/iscrm/OperationBloodMoon/Xenium/data/rds/BlockB_with_cellIDs.rds")

#subset to just rectal data

rectB<-subset(block_b, subset = tissue == "rect")

VlnPlot(rectB, features = c("nFeature_Xenium", "nCount_Xenium"), ncol = 2, pt.size = 0)
ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "nFeature_nCount_rectB.png"))

ImageDimPlot(rectB, molecules = c("ISG15", "KRT18", "ESR2", "EGR"), nmols = 1000)

ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "ImageDimPlot_rectB.png"))

rectB <- SCTransform(rectB, assay = "Xenium")

rectB<-RunPCA(rectB)

ElbowPlot(rectB)

ElbowPlot(rectB, ndims = 30)

ElbowPlot(rectB, ndims = 50)


Idents(rectB)<-"phase"
rectB<-FindNeighbors(rectB, dims = 1:25)

# OPTIONAL RIGHT NOW:default is Louvain algo, This is OPTIONAL at this point, you don't need to find clusters to be able to get the UMAP embeddings and make the UMAP plot
rectB<-FindClusters(rectB)

#This takes information from the graph made in FindNeighbors and gets embeddings for each cell, coordinates of where they are in UMAP space, using the first 10 PCs
rectB<-RunUMAP(rectB, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:25)

Idents(rectB)<-"phase"

#I want to make the UMAP with all cells one color, just to see the structure
rectB$plot_group <- "all_cells"
DimPlot(rectB, reduction = "umap", group.by = "plot_group",
        cols = "grey")

DimPlot(rectB, reduction = "umap", group.by = "phase", cols = c("orange", "blue"))

ggsave(here("Xenium", "plots", "DimPlot_UMAP_rectB.png"))

FeaturePlot(rectB, c("KRT18", "ESR2", "ISG15"))

DotPlot(rectB, c( "ESR2", "ISG15"))



rectB<-FindClusters(rectB, resolution = c(0.1, 0.25, .5, 1, 1.5, 2), algorithm = 1)
```
